controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Published Maclaurin model with semiaxes 329, 329, 294 km. The satellite orbit is assumed equatorial. The source also permits a slightly triaxial fit; this smooth shape is a constrained model. J2000 pole prior RA 20.6 ± 1.5°, DEC 46.25 ± 0.32° from satellite-orbit alignment. Arbitrary meridian; 11.05 h photometric period has aliases and is not installed as a qualified sidereal spin. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
controls.title: Published occultation shape model
